mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an active monetary easing policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for at least 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 10.0% for two consecutive months, it indicates severe labor market distress that triggers recessionary equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 10.0% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction permits (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative equity market sentiment and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline for two consecutive months, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a manufacturing supply shock (INDPRO decline > 10% over two months), equity markets anticipate reduced corporate output and higher input costs, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines by 10% or more over two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the past three months signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases for at least three consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger premature monetary tightening, causing equity markets to discount higher future interest rates and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in real GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates severe consumer and housing demand contraction, triggering negative market sentiment and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline for two consecutive months, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is at or below 0.1%, the zero lower bound constrains monetary policy effectiveness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as markets anticipate prolonged economic weakness.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is at or below 0.1%, or Rank IC for the regime falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
